QuestInfo.name: Make Those Memories
QuestInfo.0: The Temple Keeper had another idea to spark old memories.
QuestInfo.1: Get help from the Record Keeper, who keeps the entire history of Maple World.
QuestInfo.2: You met with the Record Keeper in the Record Keeper's Room, near the Resting Spot of Oblivion.

0.0: Ugh, the Tinglebrain Potion didn't work...\r\nThere's one more way. Go see the #b#p2140003##k. He spends all of his time recording events of the past. Maybe he'll know.

yes.0: Go see him at the #m270030411#, which can be accessed from #m270030410#.

no.0: I guess the Amnesiac Temple Keeper will live rest of his life not ever knowing who he is...

1.0: I was waiting for you, young adventurer.

npc.0: You still haven't gone to see the #b#p2140003##k yet? You will find him in the #b#m270030411##k, somewhere along the Road to Oblivion .
